text:
olivia: Quick—partner briefing follow-up. A few partners replied asking for co-branded snippets and early access to the slide with methodology. We need guidance: can we provide co-branded copy pre-embargo and what level of data can we share?
mina: Whoa, partners got the pre-embargo packet? Which list did we send to?
partners_bot: Sent to partners-tierA at 2026-12-20T09:00:00Z per outreach schedule. Delivery log attached in pack.
harper: Partners asked for a 1-line co-brand blurb and a co-branded PNG for their sites. Legal will need to sign off.
legal_bot: Legal rules: co-branding ok only for high-level summaries (no raw numbers) and must use approved boilerplate. Any co-branded asset requires partner contract confirmation. If partner already has a contract clause authorizing co-branding, we can proceed with a one-off approval.
olivia: Got it. Can we prepare a partner-safe blurb and a co-branded template that only references the blog URL and the safe headline (no table numbers)?
mina: I can draft a 25-word partner blurb. Also recommend a small "co-brand badge" template that overlays the partner logo with our standard footer. I'll mock and pin.
harper: Also one partner asked for the methodology slide. Legal, can we share a redacted methodology slide that removes the synthetic augmentation note until public?
legal_bot: We cannot share fuller methodology pre-embargo. Shareable: a redacted summary slide (high-level statements) is permitted. Full slide with internal notes must stay embargoed. Any redaction must be recorded in the change log and partners notified.
partners_bot: Suggestion: schedule a partner-only briefing at +20m after publish so partners get first-look post-embargo.
olivia: I prefer we keep partners on hold until public release—unless partner has an NDA with us. Which partners have NDAs?
legal_bot: Partners with NDAs: list in /contracts/partners_ndas.csv. For NDA partners, we can share redacted methodology and co-branded snippets per contract. For non-NDA partners, provide the partner-safe blurb only.
mina: Draft partner-safe blurb: "[Partner] is sharing Redwood's new inference benchmark. Read the full blog at redwood.ai/bench. For methodology details, see the methodology section after public release." Will draft variants and pin to /press/partners/.
harper: I'll create the co-brand template (placeholder logo) and mark it as NDA-only. Pin at /press/partners/co_brand_template_v1.png.
olivia: Good. Mike from partnerships wants an email subject line that is partner-friendly. Any suggestions?
mina: "Partner preview: Redwood benchmark (post-embargo access)" or "Redwood bench: co-brand assets and brief". I prefer the first.
legal_bot: Also add this sentence in any partner note: "This material is provided under existing partnership terms and remains under embargo until 2026-12-21T16:00:00Z." Must include NDA link if applicable.
partners_bot: I will queue partner DM: if partner in NDA list -> attach redacted slide + co-brand template. Else -> attach partner-safe blurb only. Send time: immediately after embargo lift.
olivia: Two operational asks: 1) Mina please pin two blurb variants (partner and press). 2) Harper, pin co-brand template and mark NDA-only. Legal, once you confirm wording, I will approve partner sends.
mina: On it. Drafts pinned at /press/partners/blurb_v1.txt and blurb_v2.txt.
harper: Co-brand template uploaded and labeled NDA-only.
legal_bot: Confirmed partner wording and embargo notice. Approve_send token for partner DM after embargo: APPROVE_PARTNERS_2123456789. Use only if partner is NDAed.
olivia: OK. Press outreach remains as scheduled to press list only. Partners will get DM only after embargo with NDA gating. Partners with NDA may get pre-embargo redacted assets if needed but default to post-embargo.
partners_bot: Partner sends queued; status: pending embargo lift. Will execute conditional send after APPROVE_PARTNERS token if NDA-partners request pre-embargo access.
mina: I'll add a one-liner for partner comms about interviews: "We can arrange a brief technical walkthrough with Redwood product leads; request via partners@redwood".
olivia: Perfect. Please react with :thumbsup: if you own the item (pinning, uploads, legal sign-off).
mina: :thumbsup:
harper: :thumbsup:
legal_bot: :thumbsup:
partners_bot: Reminder set to execute partner sends at embargo lift or on receipt of APPROVE_PARTNERS token.
olivia: Thanks team. If any partner escalates before embargo, route to me and legal immediately. We'll keep this thread for updates only.
